replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. My neuroticism score is low, so I don't get anxious easily. Math is a challenge, but it's a rewarding one. I enjoy the process of working through problems and finding solutions.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI tool to help me with some advanced math problems. It was great! The tool explained concepts clearly and provided step-by-step solutions, which helped me understand better. It was like having a helpful tutor available 24/7.

First, find the derivative of f(x), f'(x). Set f'(x) = 0 and solve for x. These x-values are potential stationary points. Then, find the second derivative f''(x). If f''(x) > 0, it's a minimum; if f''(x) < 0, it's a maximum; if f''(x) = 0, it's a saddle point.
